answer: Because ignoring a husband who is being difficult is usually the best first step, the most practical approach is simply to cut off any communication with him—no calls, texts, or in-person chats—for at least a couple of weeks; then, after you've decided whether the relationship will continue, you can figure out if you need legal help or a support group. For much of that cooling-off period you will likely feel a bit angry or resentful, so it's fine to acknowledge those emotions rather than trying to stay even; bringing up the issue right away in the middle of a conversation is often more productive than waiting to confront him.
